newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades F and G Life.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades F and G Life.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it upgraded its claims paying ability rating on Fidelity and Guaranty Life Insurance Co, a unit of USF&G Corp, to Single-A-Plus from Single-A.

Duff & Phelps said the upgrade is based on significant improvements in sales and on profit margin and on a limited guaranty agreement between F and G Life and United States Fidelity and Guaranty Co, also a unit of USF&G.

"F and G Life has made very good progress though improved sales, especially of asset accumulation products, resulting in growth of 22 percent in 1996," Duff & Phelps said, adding it expects continued growth.
Duff & Phelps noted, however, there are risks associated with the development of the company's product lines and distribution systems, as well as long-term competition.
